name: GitHub Copilot Evals
desc: Run evals on your own prompts, skills, agents and MCP tools.
desc_zh: 对你自己的提示、技能、Agent 和 MCP 工具跑评测。
solves: You change a prompt or swap a model and have no idea whether it got worse. Evals reruns the same setup so the comparison is a measurement, not a feeling.
solves_zh: 改了提示或换了模型，你并不知道是不是变差了。Evals 用同一套配置重跑，让比较变成测量而不是感觉。
best_for: A prompt, skill or tool changed and you need to know what it cost you.
best_for_zh: 提示、技能或工具刚改过，你需要知道代价是什么。
notes: 外部发现补录（发现渠道：D — GitHub Changelog, https://github.blog/changelog/2026-11-17-github-copilot-ev）。 Public preview only. Scoped to the skills, agents and MCP tools in your own setup, not to Copilot itself. 首次公开日期来源：https://github.blog/changelog/2026-11-17-github-copilot-evals-is-now-in-public-preview/
